phonetically_fragile_spans.why: alphanumeric ids mis-recognise in noisy audio
spoken dates collapse across similar-sounding numbers

observable_behaviors: Keeps turns short -- rarely more than two sentences.
Pushes the agent to act rather than explain; skips pleasantries.
States the goal early and repeats it if the agent digresses.
Accepts a correct answer immediately and ends the call.
Asks a clarifying question before agreeing to anything consequential.
Restates figures back to the agent to confirm understanding.
Volunteers context the agent did not ask for.
Needs reassurance before committing; hesitates once.
Challenges a figure at least once and asks how it was arrived at.
Does not accept the first explanation without a reason.
Is willing to proceed once given an evidenced answer.
Becomes terse when the agent cannot substantiate a claim.
Misreads domain terminology and asks for it in plain words.
Needs each instruction confirmed before moving on.
Cannot follow an app-based instruction without a spoken alternative.
Repeats what the agent said to check they understood.
Says at the outset how little time they have.
Interrupts a long explanation to ask for the outcome.
Accepts a callback rather than waiting.
Will not sit through an options list.

rules.name: Attempt limit
rules.rule: No re-attempt may be scheduled once the attempt limit is reached; the consignment returns to origin.

rules.name: Serviceability
rules.rule: An address outside the serviceable pincode list cannot be delivered to, whatever the customer offers.

rules.name: Liability truth
rules.rule: Compensation may only be discussed where the shipment record shows it insured, and only up to the declared value.

rules.name: Scan truth
rules.rule: Location may only be described from the last scan the tool returns.

forbidden_actions: Scheduling a re-attempt past the attempt limit.
Promising compensation on an uninsured consignment.
Inventing a delivery date or location.

user_known_facts.request: Parcel wapas ja raha hai, address galat bola unhone.
Ek baar aur bhej dijiye please.
Do hafte ho gaye, parcel ka kuch pata nahi.

user_known_facts.note: the courier called; the consignee did not ring in
user_known_facts.context: Delivery failed twice and the parcel is about to return.

user_known_facts.request: Mera parcel kahan atka hua hai?

check_delivery_exception.purpose: Return why a delivery failed and what can still be done.

lookup_shipment.purpose: Retrieve consignment status, scan history, attempts made and declared value.

schedule_reattempt.purpose: Book another delivery attempt, optionally with a corrected address.

verify_customer_identity.purpose: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

shipment_tracking.purpose: Explain where a consignment is, resolve delivery exceptions and arrange re-attempts within the attempt limit.
shipment_tracking.business_context: Indian courier contact centre. Callers chase parcels, correct addresses and book pickups. Liability, insurance and re-attempt limits are policy-bound.

terminal_success_conditions: Re-attempt scheduled with the remaining attempts stated.
Consignee told why delivery cannot proceed and what happens next.
escalation_conditions: Consignment is marked lost and the declared value exceeds the insured limit.

valid_tool_sequence_patterns.note: the verification's result must justify the action's arguments
